## Load Packages & Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)

glimpse(penguins)
```

## Summary Table of Average Bill Length by Species

```{r}
data_summary <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    avg_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

data_summary
```

## Plot of Average Bill Length by Species

```{r}
data_summary |>
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(x = species, y = avg_bill_length)
  ) +
  geom_col(fill = "pink") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Bill Length by Penguin Species",
    x = "Species Name",
    y = "Average Bill Length (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
